reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

common_contract.population: Only ten explicitly authored directions. Six native capsules and ten located rows are inquiry inputs, not admissions or a positive quota.
common_contract.actual_use: A real integrated subject/result is consumed for an actual commitment, cross-level obligation or control-selection decision, or those decisions provide an actual condition for integration. The rejected-universal directions separately concern the actual general rule or its actual enforcement on this work; phase names alone are insufficient.
common_contract.partial_input: A relevant combined result, criterion or constraint may be useful before the receiving review, lifecycle or tailoring arrangement wholly succeeds. A known failed necessary same-scoped condition can refute one premise while others remain unknown. A green sample cannot supply authority, all obligations or whole cost justification.
common_contract.polarity: Material means an important directed relationship, including INVALIDATION and CONFLICT_AT_SHARED_GUARD. The four P034/P035 directions do not retain, rehabilitate or endorse the rejected universal rules. Their native rejected status and legitimate bounded alternatives remain explicit.
common_contract.evidence_kind: Nine exact old C27 case objects are reused. Their five dependent observations and eight component calls instantiate real finite composition, not an organisational mainline, a phase scheduler, a requirements-completeness gate or an empowered review. Policy implications below are native/analytical conditions, not observed policy executions. No C25/C27 joint run is invented.
common_contract.history: Earlier assignments, 476 unknowns and their discriminators, missing originals and failures remain exact. The storage-failed PREPARE_I010_RUN001 recorder never invoked its source; fresh authorized RUN002 is a separately observed first source invocation. No successful old scientific program is rerun.

directions.source_contribution: A real combined state replaces component or document completion as the technical object. A credible known interaction failure can challenge a commitment premise; a current pass supplies only its scoped evidence.
directions.receiving_consequence: The actual review can recognize the anomaly, narrow readiness or seek further evidence before go, redirect, hold or stop. Which disposition is warranted still depends on the real decision and unresolved premises.
directions.remaining_premises: Actual commitment/exposure, decision rights, relevant criteria, challenge access, residual risks and willingness to act. The integration result creates none of that authority.
directions.positive_witness: C27's mixed pair fails required3 with output300 despite local passes. If that combined condition is necessary to an actual contemplated commitment, the failure is informative even before the whole review is ready. Its coherent sample pass is only bounded support.
directions.nontrigger_or_counterexample: A meeting that consumes no relevant combined evidence, or a green badge used as automatic permission, supplies no such justified review input. An ordinary internal merge need not constitute an irreversible commitment.
directions.cheap_alternative_and_removal: An adequate current result and an asynchronous owned decision can replace a repeat run and board meeting. Removing all actual-state correspondence loses the premise; removing ceremony while retaining it need not.
directions.reentry: Revisit on changed combined target, actual decision, necessary condition, evidence validity or residual risk.

That policy distinction is reasoned, not executed in C27.
